version_name: Version 1.4.4 API settings consolidation and metadata alignment
description: Promotes the current local-desktop app version metadata and documentation references to 1.4.4, repairs legacy local audit-log schemas that still contain retired FHIR required columns, clarifies the single active Alleva/API connection in App settings and the API harness, preserves encrypted client-secret handling, and keeps the existing Version 1 local Windows desktop boundaries.
